headline: Wardens Raise Flag at Fort Ember as Front Casualties Mount
war_summary: Since our last edition, the news of record comes from Fisherman's Row, where Warden forces have raised their colors over Fort Ember in the freshest base action on the maps, logged less than an hour before this edition went to press. The Linn of Mercy, which led the previous report, keeps its casualty surge, the Warden toll plainly the heavier there, though recorded base actions have slowed to a single entry in the past two hours. The Weathered Expanse, held six posts Warden to three Colonial, has gone quiet on the event ledger while its casualty bill continues to climb. The Dead Lands stir again near Callahan's Gate, losses running sharply against the Wardens, and the Nevish Line bleeds in the opposite proportion, Colonial casualties outstripping all others in the last two hours. Marban Hollow has erupted from near-silence into a heavy exchange, and the Stlican Shelf grinds on five bases to four. Callahans Passage, for so long the war's grimmest ledger, has cooled markedly. Day 317 closes with no victor declared and thirty-four victory towns still the prize.
